parameters.formTitle: Report a Bug from a Screenshot
parameters.formDescription: Upload one or more screenshots. Groq vision drafts a Jira bug, you approve it, then the bug is created and the ORIGINAL screenshots are attached.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $('Normalize Screenshots').first().json.groq_vision_model, temperature: 0.2, max_completion_tokens: 800, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: $('Normalize Screenshots').first().json.vision_system_prompt }, { role: 'user', content: [ { type: 'text', text: $('Normalize Screenshots').first().json.vision_user_prompt }, { type: 'image_url', image_url: { url: 'data:' + ($('Normalize Screenshots').first().binary[$('Normalize Screenshots').first().json.primary_binary_property].mimeType || 'image/png') + ';base64,' + $('Normalize Screenshots').first().binary[$('Normalize Screenshots').first().json.primary_binary_property].data } } ] } ] }) }}

additionalFields.description:
={{ $('Evaluate Duplicates').first().json.bug.description }} + '

Steps to reproduce:
' + $('Evaluate Duplicates').first().json.bug.steps_to_reproduce + '

Expected result:
' + $('Evaluate Duplicates').first().json.bug.expected_result + '

Actual result:
' + $('Evaluate Duplicates').first().json.bug.actual_result + '

Severity: ' + $('Evaluate Duplicates').first().json.bug.severity + '
Environment: ' + $('Evaluate Duplicates').first().json.bug.environment

nodeGroups.name: Capture & validate screenshot
nodeGroups.description: Upload form, collect every screenshot binary, reject missing/non-image/oversize uploads

nodeGroups.name: Vision bug draft
nodeGroups.description: Groq vision reads the original image and drafts a strict JSON bug report; retried and validated

nodeGroups.name: Duplicate check & human approval
nodeGroups.description: Search for likely duplicate bugs, then a second form page for an explicit approve/reject

nodeGroups.name: Create bug & attach screenshot
nodeGroups.description: Create the Jira bug, dedupe existing attachments, upload the original binary as multipart/form-data, verify

nodeGroups.name: Final result
nodeGroups.description: Report full success, partial success or failure with a safe retry hint on the form's ending page
